# apple_start_app_store_version_experiment (Action)

Starts a product page optimization experiment, which then shows its treatments to visitors for up to 90 days. An experiment that needs review must be approved first, and it can't change once it has started.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_start_app_store_version_experiment" "icons" {
  config {
    experiment_id = apple_app_store_version_experiment.icons.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `experiment_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the experiment, e.g. `apple_app_store_version_experiment.example.id`.
